resources.string: Turn this device into a cellular base station. Other devices can connect to it directly without a carrier network.
Connect to a nearby CellLink tower. Make calls and send messages directly device-to-device.
Root access is required for modem control
DIAG port access required. Dial *#0808# to enable.

This software is for authorized security research and lab testing only. Operating a transmitter without a license is illegal in most jurisdictions. Use only in a Faraday cage or with proper authorization.
